Fix broken blog images: protect underscores from italic parsing and fix image paths The markdown parser's underscore-italic rule was mangling underscores in image filenames (e.g. _left_enhanced → leftenhanced). Fixed by protecting raw HTML tags and generated img/link tags from italic processing. Also fixed image paths from ../images/ to images/ so they resolve correctly relative to the generated HTML in the blog/ directory. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5

Remove Feedly subscribe button

The Feedly button was causing "invalid feed ids" errors because it was passing the wrong URL. Users can already:
1. Copy the feed URL using the "Copy Feed URL" button
2. Let their RSS reader auto-discover the feed via RSS autodiscovery link in page head

Simplified to just the copy button which is more reliable and user-friendly.

Fix: Generate valid Feedly subscription link

- Change Feedly button to call JavaScript function instead of static link
- Function dynamically constructs the subscription URL with proper feed URL encoding
- Fixes "invalid feed ids" error by passing the actual RSS feed URL to Feedly

Fix: Include blog/rss.xml in workflow git add

The build script regenerates rss.xml with updated lastBuildDate, but the workflow wasn't staging it for commit. This caused the action to fail with "Changes not staged for commit" error even though no changes were meant to be committed.

Now includes blog/rss.xml in the git add command alongside other generated files.

Transform animation to Epoch of Reionization simulation

Replace generic particle system with scientifically accurate visualization:

Background animation:
- Growing ionized bubbles representing HII regions
- Twinkling stars as ionization sources
- Bubbles expand outward from stellar sources over time
- Radial gradients with glowing edges for ionization fronts
- Up to 30 simultaneous bubbles, spawning every 150 frames

21-cm signal visualization:
- Live plot in top-right corner showing characteristic signal
- Absorption trough during reionization epoch
- Signal spans redshift z~6 to z~20
- Captures key features: pre-reionization, deep absorption, recovery
- Theme-aware styling with semi-transparent background

Physics accuracy:
- Represents Cosmic Dawn and Epoch of Reionization
- First stars ionize surrounding neutral hydrogen
- Ionized regions (HII bubbles) grow and eventually overlap
- Corresponds to 21-cm absorption signal observed by experiments

Creates immediate visual connection between the animation and
global 21-cm experiments like REACH studying these epochs.
